title: Barbarin's birth date and age; starting music at 14
summary: He says he was born September 24, 1872, is 87, and took up music about age 14.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Do you like your father playing music?
No. And also how old he is. No.
You want to know how old you are?
Tell him. Tell him what year you was born in and how old you are.
1872. What's the birth date? I was born in 1872.
87. When did you take up music?
When did you take up music?
I was about 14 years old. What instrument? About 14 years old.
